agents.name: Document Intelligence
agents.one_liner: OCR plus a language model pull structured fields out of scanned freight paperwork.

score.label: per-field accuracy
score.note: on 20 of 40 planned rows — the rest wait on the daily LLM quota

agents.deterministic: Field comparison and error detection are rules; the model only reads the page.

agents.name: Order Entry
agents.role: Turns customer emails into TMS orders
agents.one_liner: Reads a booking email, validates it, and either files the order or asks exactly one question.

score.label: cases correct
score.note: 50 of 50 authored cases, 0 orders filed on invented values

agents.deterministic: Validation and the decision to ask are arithmetic; the model writes the question.

agents.name: Tracking & Exception
agents.one_liner: Takes a delay alert off the stream, grades its severity, notifies the customer and files a ticket.

score.label: notification precision (as-of)
score.note: against 54.1% for alerting every leg. The published 72.1% came from a replay that leaked future history (D-054).

agents.deterministic: Severity is computed from the predicted gap; the model writes the customer sentence.

agents.name: Freight Invoice Auditor
agents.one_liner: Checks a freight invoice against the order and the corridor's own measured rate band.

score.label: of 20 verdicts matched
score.note: no clean invoice disputed. The band is the corpus's own rate model — exact here, circular as a pricing claim (D-043).

agents.deterministic: The verdict is arithmetic against a rate band; the model writes the dispute note.

agents.name: Analytics Assistant
agents.one_liner: Retrieval over the project's own corridor, hub and document index — and a refusal when the answer is not in it.

score.label: groundedness of model-written answers
score.note: route accuracy 0.9 on the fixed question set; all out-of-scope questions refused

agents.deterministic: Routing and retrieval are code; the model phrases the answer, and can be switched off entirely.

orchestrator.note: Ten emails, three distinct paths, no human in the middle.
